claims.claim: Lifecycle accumulates real verification counts on a real observation stream
claims.evidence: 5 edge(s) reached verification_count>=2 by merging repeated observations

claims.claim: Lifecycle promotes USEFUL (cross-page) navigation edges from this corpus
claims.evidence: 0 cross-page edge(s) promoted; 2 promoted edge(s) are degenerate self-loops (empty-target Type/Swipe that stay on the page) — cross-page taps key on raw pixels that drift between runs (max coordinate vc=2), so none reach vc>=3

claims.claim: Outcome distributions flag NON-DETERMINISTIC transitions (same action -> >1 outcome)
claims.evidence: 2 multi-modal distribution(s), 2 above the VLM-verify entropy threshold (0.5) — but these are BENIGN timing races (identical pixel, 'did the tap register'), since all 6 trajs are labelled success

claims.claim: Outcome distributions flag ADVERSARIAL interference (popup / login-wall / captcha / wrong-product)
claims.evidence: 0 failure/interference trajs in corpus — the headline RQ2 'catch misbehavior' claim has zero supporting samples until these are collected

claims.claim: sava is strictly more conservative than legacy (fewer promotions)
claims.evidence: legacy promoted 34/34 (every edge on first write) vs sava 2/34 on identical input

collection_asks: Collect >=10 real-device trajectories that DELIBERATELY hit failure / interference (popup, login-wall, captcha, wrong-product selection). The corpus already shows 2 BENIGN (timing-race) multi-modal distribution(s), but ZERO adversarial-interference ones — the headline RQ2 'catch misbehavior' claim needs the latter.

ZERO cross-page navigation edges promoted under sava: the only promotions are degenerate empty-target self-loops. Either (a) make promotion key on the enriched SEMANTIC target so repeated cross-page taps merge, or (b) accept that raw-pixel taps cannot earn promotion and rely on bootstrap promotion for navigation edges.

3 edge(s) sit at vc=2 (one verified repeat short of sava promotion). For EMPTY-target edges (Swipe/Type) re-running the same task tips them over; for coordinate taps it will not, because the pixels drift between runs.
For coordinate-tap edges to accumulate vc across runs, promotion must key on the enriched SEMANTIC target (region+page affordance), not raw pixels; otherwise each run is a fresh edge.
